basic_profile.bio: An avid gamer and hockey enthusiast from Calgary, Canada. I spend my evenings diving into the world of NHLHUT, trying to snag the best players for my team. Typically online after 6 PM when I'm off work from my job as a graphic designer. I'm single, and I like to unwind with a good game or a funny video. Not a fan of early mornings or strict routines.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have been playing NHL video games since I was a kid. My knowledge comes from years of playing, watching YouTube tutorials, and participating in online forums. I also have a background in graphic design, which sometimes helps me appreciate the visual aspects of games.
